channel.title: NucleusFlow: Fast, Secure Rust Static Site Generator & Content Pipeline
channel.description: Fast, flexible, and secure static site generator and content processing pipeline in Rust. Parse CommonMark + GFM, render cached Handlebars templates, and minify HTML5 in ~28 microseconds per page with zero unsafe code.
